scope: Official physical-remote feature evidence. This does not certify RF encoding or timing.
page_numbering: PDF pages are 1-based. Printed pages follow the document footer; some PDF pages contain two printed pages.
established_features: Brief UP/DOWN can start endpoint travel on roller shutters and awnings.
Suitable Venetian JA and Combio JA Pulse receivers support jog or pulse movement after a brief UP/DOWN press.
Holding UP/DOWN until the status indicator lights starts endpoint travel on the described Venetian receivers.
Basic movement requires a learned transmitter/channel and set drive end positions, not a saved intermediate or tilt preset.
Combio JA Pulse stores a configurable receiver pulse duration, distinct from a saved position or transmitted release delay.
not_established: RF command byte values, addressing envelope, repeat count, or release byte.
A numerical short/long button threshold for these instructions.
That the implemented three press and three release packets match every physical remote.
That a short press always produces a small movement on every receiver.
